schema:description: Helium gas pycnometry performed at UCa after approximately three hours of atmospheric exposure for grain density measurement of Bennu angular lithology particle OREX-800123-0. The bundled data contains instrument calibration and verification results, grain density measurement results for sample OREX-800123-0, and methods description. These data apparently constrain a valid grain density.
